cover_metadata.cover_rule: Present review identity and disposition before findings.

tables.overflow: Split findings by stable ID and repeat context columns on continuation pages.

callouts.rule: Severity requires a text label, evidence, owner, and disposition; color alone is insufficient.

diagram_placement.rule: Place dependency or flow diagrams with the finding cluster they explain and retain readable labels.

image_placement.rule: Use dated, redacted annotations tied to finding IDs; do not use decorative evidence.

captions_alt_text.rule: Caption each visual with finding ID, reviewed state, and purpose; describe relevant annotations in alt text.

headers_footers.footer: Artifact version, review date, confidentiality, and page number

source_notes.rule: Each finding identifies evidence location, capture date, inference boundary, and unavailable evidence.

pagination.orphan_control: Keep finding title, severity, and first evidence block together.
pagination.overflow_policy: Continue long evidence or action tables with repeated finding IDs and headers; never truncate.
pagination.empty_page_policy: Reject blank review pages and empty finding sections before approval.
